traditions.VUL: ita præcépit Móyses Iósue ,
traditions.KJV: so did Moses command Joshua ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כֵן֙ עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς ·
traditions.VUL: et ille univérsa complévit :
traditions.KJV: and so did Joshua ;

15.english_reference: he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא הֵסִ֣יר דָּבָ֔ר מִ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
traditions.LXX: οὐ παρέβη οὐδὲν ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν συνέταξεν αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς .
traditions.VUL: non prætériit de univérsis mandátis , nec unum quidem verbum quod iússerat Dóminus Móysi .
traditions.KJV: he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses .

16.english_reference: So Joshua took all that land , the hills , and all the south country

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת כָּל הָ אָ֣רֶץ הַ זֹּ֗את הָ הָ֤ר וְ אֶת כָּל הַ נֶּ֨גֶב֙
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν τὴν ὀρεινὴν καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Ἄδεβ
traditions.VUL: Cepit ítaque Iósue omnem terram montánam , et meridiánam ,
traditions.KJV: So Joshua took all that land , the hills , and all the south country ,

16.english_reference: and all the land of Goshen , and the valley , and the plain

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֙ כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ גֹּ֔שֶׁן וְ אֶת הַ שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וְ אֶת הָ עֲרָבָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Γόσομ καὶ τὴν πεδινὴν καὶ τὴν πρὸς δυσμαῖς ,
traditions.VUL: terrámque Gosen , et planítiem , et occidentálem plagam ,
traditions.KJV: and all the land of Goshen , and the valley , and the plain ,

16.english_reference: and the mountain of Israel , and the valley of the same

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּ שְׁפֵלָתֹֽ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ ὄρος Ἰσραὴλ καὶ τὰ ταπεινὰ .
traditions.VUL: montémque Israel , et campéstria eius :
traditions.KJV: and the mountain of Israel , and the valley of the same ;

17.english_reference: [ Even ] from the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir

traditions.WLC: מִן הָ הָ֤ר הֶֽ חָלָק֙ הָ עוֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֔יר
traditions.LXX: τὰ πρὸς τῷ ὄρει ἀπὸ ὄρους Ἁχέλ , καὶ ὃ προσαναβαίνει εἰς Σηεὶρ
traditions.VUL: et partem montis , quæ ascéndit Seir
traditions.KJV: [ Even ] from the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir ,

17.english_reference: even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon

traditions.WLC: וְ עַד בַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּ בִקְעַ֣ת הַ לְּבָנ֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת הַר חֶרְמ֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἕως Βαλαγάδ , καὶ τὰ πεδία τοῦ Λιβάνου ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ἁερμών ·
traditions.VUL: usque Baálgad , per planítiem Líbani subter montem Hermon :
traditions.KJV: even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon :

17.english_reference: and all their kings he took , and smote them , and slew them

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֤ת כָּל מַלְכֵי הֶם֙ לָכַ֔ד וַ יַּכֵּ֖ ם וַ יְמִיתֵֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντας τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἔλαβεν καὶ ἀνεῖλεν καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν .
traditions.VUL: omnes reges eórum cepit , percússit , et occídit .
traditions.KJV: and all their kings he took , and smote them , and slew them .

18.english_reference: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings

traditions.WLC: יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת כָּל הַ מְּלָכִ֥ים הָ אֵ֖לֶּה מִלְחָמָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ πλείους ἡμέρας ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς βασιλεῖς τούτους τὸν πόλεμον .
traditions.VUL: Multo témpore pugnávit Iósue contra reges istos .
traditions.KJV: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings .

19.english_reference: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא הָיְתָ֣ה עִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלִ֨ימָה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἦν πόλις ἣν οὐκ ἔλαβεν Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: Non fuit cívitas quæ se tráderet fíliis Israel ,
traditions.KJV: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel ,

19.english_reference: save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon

traditions.WLC: בִּלְתִּ֥י הַ חִוִּ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן
traditions.VUL: præter Hevǽum , qui habitábat in Gábaon :
traditions.KJV: save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon :

19.english_reference: all [ other ] they took in battle

traditions.WLC: אֶת הַ כֹּ֖ל לָקְח֥וּ בַ מִּלְחָמָֽה
traditions.LXX: πάντα ἐλάβοσαν ἐν πολέμῳ ,
traditions.VUL: omnes enim bellándo cepit .
traditions.KJV: all [ other ] they took in battle .

20.english_reference: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י מֵ אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה הָיְתָ֡ה לְ חַזֵּ֣ק אֶת לִבָּ ם֩
traditions.LXX: ὅτι διὰ Κυρίου ἐγένετο κατισχῦσαι αὐτῶν τὴν καρδίαν
traditions.VUL: Dómini enim senténtia fúerat , ut induraréntur corda eórum ,
traditions.KJV: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts ,

20.english_reference: that they should come against Israel in battle

traditions.WLC: לִ קְרַ֨את הַ מִּלְחָמָ֤ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙
traditions.LXX: συναντᾷν εἰς πόλεμον πρὸς Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: et pugnárent contra Israel ,
traditions.KJV: that they should come against Israel in battle ,

20.english_reference: that he might destroy them utterly , [ and ] that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֣עַן הַֽחֲרִימָ֔ ם לְ בִלְתִּ֥י הֱיוֹת לָ הֶ֖ם תְּחִנָּ֑ה כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן הַשְׁמִידָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: ἵνα ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν , ὅπως μὴ δοθῇ αὐτοῖς ἔλεος ἀλλ᾽ ἵνα ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν
traditions.VUL: et cáderent , et non mereréntur ullam cleméntiam , ac perírent ,
traditions.KJV: that he might destroy them utterly , [ and ] that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them ,

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
traditions.LXX: ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν .
traditions.VUL: sicut præcéperat Dóminus Móysi .
traditions.KJV: as the LORD commanded Moses .

21.english_reference: And at that time came Joshua

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּ עֵ֣ת הַ הִ֗יא
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ
traditions.VUL: In illo témpore venit Iósue ,
traditions.KJV: And at that time came Joshua ,

21.english_reference: and cut off the Anakims from the mountains

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכְרֵ֤ת אֶת הָֽ עֲנָקִים֙ מִן הָ הָ֤ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν τοὺς Ἐνακεὶμ ἐκ τῆς ὀρεινῆς ,
traditions.VUL: et interfécit Enacim de montánis ,
traditions.KJV: and cut off the Anakims from the mountains ,

21.english_reference: from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab

traditions.WLC: מִן חֶבְרוֹן֙ מִן דְּבִ֣ר מִן עֲנָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: ἐκ Χεβρὼν καὶ ἐκ Δαβεὶρ καὶ ἐξ Ἀναβὼθ
traditions.VUL: Hebron , et Dabir , et Anab ,
traditions.KJV: from Hebron , from Debir , from Anab ,

21.english_reference: and from all the mountains of Judah , and from all the mountains of Israel

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ כֹּל֙ הַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ מִ כֹּ֖ל הַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκ παντὸς γένους Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐκ παντὸς ὄρους Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: et de omni monte Iuda et Israel ,
traditions.KJV: and from all the mountains of Judah , and from all the mountains of Israel :

21.english_reference: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities

traditions.WLC: עִם עָרֵי הֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִימָ֥ ם יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
traditions.LXX: σὺν ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτῶν · καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς .
traditions.VUL: urbésque eórum delévit .
traditions.KJV: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities .

22.english_reference: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא נוֹתַ֣ר עֲנָקִ֔ים בְּ אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: οὐ κατελείφθη τῶν Ἐνακεὶμ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Non relíquit ullum de stirpe Enacim , in terra filiórum Israel :
traditions.KJV: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel :

22.english_reference: only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained

traditions.WLC: רַ֗ק בְּ עַזָּ֛ה בְּ גַ֥ת וּ בְ אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד נִשְׁאָֽרוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀλλὰ πλὴν ἐν Γάζῃ καὶ ἐν Ἀσελδὼ κατελείφθη .
traditions.VUL: absque civitátibus Gaza , et Geth , et Azóto , in quibus solis relícti sunt .
traditions.KJV: only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained .

23.english_reference: So Joshua took the whole land

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת כָּל הָ אָ֗רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ,
traditions.VUL: Cepit ergo Iósue omnem terram ,
traditions.KJV: So Joshua took the whole land ,

23.english_reference: according to all that the LORD said unto Moses

traditions.WLC: כְּ֠ כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒
traditions.LXX: καθότι ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ ·
traditions.VUL: sicut locútus est Dóminus ad Móysen ,
traditions.KJV: according to all that the LORD said unto Moses ;

23.english_reference: and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנָ הּ֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ לְ נַחֲלָ֧ה לְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כְּ מַחְלְקֹתָ֖ ם לְ שִׁבְטֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς ἐν κληρονομίᾳ Ἰσραήλ ἐν μερισμῷ κατὰ φυλὰς αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et trádidit eam in possessiónem fíliis Israel secúndum partes et tribus suas :
traditions.KJV: and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes .

23.english_reference: And the land rested from war

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ אָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִ מִּלְחָמָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ γῆ κατέπαυσεν πολεμουμένη .
traditions.VUL: quievítque terra a prœ́liis .
traditions.KJV: And the land rested from war .
